items.name: Regions and Availability Zones
items.explanation: A cloud region is a separate geographic area. Availability zones are several isolated locations inside one region, so a test can place replicas in the same zone, in different zones of one region, or in different regions.

assumedBy.quote: same Availability Zone as the primary

sources.title: Regions and Zones, Amazon EC2 User Guide
